tests.title: Cleaning and disinfection of ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEM
tests.description: Check compliance by inspection of the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. Clean and disinfect CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE or its parts or ACCESSORIES 100 times in accordance with methods indicated in the instruction for use, including any cooling or drying period. After these PROCEDURES, confirm that BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE are maintained.

tests.title: Additional requirements for accuracy of controls and instruments
tests.description: When the CLINICAL THERMOMETER is not capable of indicating a temperature within the LABORATORY ACCURACY, it shall provide a TECHNICAL ALARM CONDITION or it shall not provide an OUTPUT TEMPERATURE.
results_observed: The CLINICAL THERMOMETER shows 'LOW POWER REMINDER' symbol when low voltage of the internal electrical power source.
The CLINICAL THERMOMETER shows '- - -°F' or '- - -℃' when output temperature is outside the rated extended output range.

semantic_fragments.content: Clause 201.11.6.6: When compliance with this document could be affected by the cleaning or the disinfecting of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE or its parts or ACCESSORIES, clean and disinfect them 100 times in accordance with the methods indicated in the instruction for use, including any cooling or drying period. After these PROCEDURES, confirm that BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE are maintained. Confirm that the MANUFACTURER has evaluated the effects of multiple PROCESS cycles and the effectiveness of those cycles.

Clause 201.12.1.101: When the CLINICAL THERMOMETER is not capable of indicating a temperature within the LABORATORY ACCURACY, it shall provide a TECHNICAL ALARM CONDITION or it shall not provide an OUTPUT TEMPERATURE. Test result: The CLINICAL THERMOMETER shows 'LOW POWER REMINDER' symbol when low voltage of the internal electrical power source. The CLINICAL THERMOMETER shows '- - -°F' or '- - -℃' when output temperature is outside the rated extended output range.
